context_requirements: Expression of SLC6A4 (serotonin transporter) and intact serotonergic signaling machinery
Presence of serotonin synthesis, storage, or receptor-mediated downstream pathways
Cell lines are not known to be responsive to SSRIs at the transcriptional level in the 6-24 h window
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of serotonergic or monoamine-related transcriptional signatures after treatment
Consistent upregulation of immediate early genes (e.g., FOS, JUN) or stress markers across multiple lines
